ITEM 1 | Mass of dark green, ruffled, thin-stemmed leafy greens with lobed edges, loosely piled in the lower-center of a white square plate, covering roughly 35-40% of the plate's surface, about 12 cm across and 3-4 cm tall, with pale green stems visible; dry-looking matte leaves with little sheen | 60
ITEM 2 | Scattered small reddish-brown pieces with slightly wrinkled, glossy surfaces mixed among the greens, roughly 0.5-1.5 cm each, some appearing chewy and semi-moist, sitting on and between the leaves in the center-left of the pile | 12
ITEM 3 | Small golden-tan crisp pieces with irregular edges and a light toasted look, scattered among the greens and along the right edge, each about 0.5-1 cm, dry and brittle in appearance | 6
ITEM 4 | Light brown, flat, slightly curled piece with a dry, crisp-looking surface near the right edge of the greens, about 2 x 1.5 cm, sitting partly off the leaf pile on the plate | 4
ITEM 5 | Small pale golden-brown bits with a rough, slightly granular texture scattered at the bottom edge of the greens, about 0.5 cm each, dry-looking and nubby | 2
